description.value:
If you move at least 30 feet in a straight line right before attacking a creature and you hit it with melee weapon attack, that target must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked Prone. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

You can move up to half your Speed as a Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 10 feet of you after moving towards you and you are not already within 5 feet of a different enemy. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

activation.condition: when an enemy ends its turn within 10 feet of you after moving towards you and you are not already within 5 feet of a different enemy
